summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 24, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor covering an 8% original issue discount senior convertible promissory note of $4,347,826 principal, 12-month term, with $86,956 additional discount paid via 110,070 ordinary shares at $0.79. Conversion price is the lower of a $0.9842 fixed price or 92% of the seven-day lowest VWAP (85% on default), subject to a floor. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
